title: Loft wardrobe doors on the timber frame

options.name: The design
options.text: Three shaker doors fitted on the face of the timber frame you already have. On the left, a pair of tall doors across the wide opening; on the right, one door cut to follow the angle of the sloping beam. A timber stud goes on the left wall so the hinges have something solid to fix to, and the rails inside stay as they are.

poster.alt: 3D model of three shaker doors on a loft timber frame, a pair on the left and one angled door under the sloping beam on the right

notes: The width, the height to the ceiling and the two openings either side of the post are measured.
The angle of the sloping beam, the height where it meets the wall and the depth inside are taken from the photos and will be checked on site.
The doors are 22 mm MDF shaker doors with a 70 mm frame; these are standard sizes to start from.
Handles are not shown yet: tell me if you would like knobs, bar handles or push to open doors.
Colours on screen are a guide.
